scope: A05 managed-user nickname edit contract mirror; implementation and acceptance remain pending

request.path_guid: canonical positive decimal signed int64 string (1..9223372036854775807), no sign, whitespace, or leading zero

headers.Authorization: required Bearer authentication under the existing mechanism

request.strict_json: one JSON object; reject duplicate keys, case-folded duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, trailing values, unknown fields, and oversized bodies before service invocation

nickname.rule: required; null clears display name; strings trim surrounding whitespace and must then contain 1..64 Unicode code points

body.forbidden_field_policy: only nickname and expected_auth_version are accepted; guid, username, role, auth_version, status, password, group_guid, plan_type, allowed_models, daily_call_limit, permission_overrides, amount and balance fields, and every other field are rejected before persistence

errors.400: invalid path, JSON, field, or nickname
errors.403: missing users.edit capability or hierarchy denied

legacy_put.rule: not a new-interface write entry point and not expanded by A05
